tasks.short: Develop or use mathematical models for weather forecasting

steps.what: Develop or select mathematical and computer models suited to weather forecasting objectives
outputs: selected model configuration and scientific rationale

steps.what: Use weather models and assess configuration validity, diagnostic results and limitations
inputs: selected model configuration and scientific rationale

tasks.design: Retain model development, selection and validity checks using {DATA_PLATFORM} and {DOCS}. Numerical or machine-learning forecast execution already performed by computing infrastructure does not itself establish a new reduction in scientist time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Model suitability depends on forecast objectives, data coverage and scientific limitations.
tasks.enabler_now: Operational numerical and machine-learning forecasts provide candidate model evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Determine when a model's apparent skill is relevant and reliable.
tasks.human_edge: Choose defensible model assumptions and recognise failure regimes.
tasks.altitude: Own model suitability and scientific limitations.

reach.task: Challenge model assumptions and validation design

evidence.claim: ECMWF made AIFS operational beside its physics model in February 2025; reported forecast-skill and energy gains do not measure scientist labour savings here.

assumptions: The baseline is scientist development, selection and checked use, excluding unattended compute runtime.
Model input preparation and diagnostic checks remain within s2; no validated input packet appears without work.
No new service is installed, so there is no added automation upkeep.
Forecast interpretation is counted in its own task rather than duplicated here.
research_questions: Is repeated model setup measurable independently of scientific development and existing automated execution?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Scientific model work remains; compute energy or runtime improvements are not labour savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interpret meteorological evidence to predict weather conditions

steps.what: Interpret data, reports, maps, photographs and charts to predict weather conditions

tasks.design: Keep weather interpretation and uncertainty assessment with the scientist using {DATA_PLATFORM} and source material in {DOCS}. Existing model guidance supports judgement without establishing that human synthesis or extreme-event assessment takes less time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Predictions require reconciling observations, model disagreement and local conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing weather systems provide observations and model guidance.
tasks.still_hard: Recognise misleading guidance and explain uncertainty in changing conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Integrate physical understanding with conflicting evidence.
tasks.altitude: Own the evidential basis of weather predictions.

reach.task: Resolve uncertainty in satellite or radar evidence

evidence.claim: Operational model capability exists in the digest, but forecast interpretation labour savings are not established.

assumptions: This baseline is interpretation and synthesis, excluding model development and separately measured data preparation.
No structured severe-weather or confidence flag is treated as a substitute for assessment.
The broader environmental-prediction task must not count the same weather interpretation minutes again.
No new automation service or added maintenance is proposed.
research_questions: Is repeated display preparation measurable separately from forecast judgement?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Weather interpretation remains; model skill gains are not assumed to reduce labour.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research atmospheric processes, weather and climate

steps.what: Define meteorological research methods and validate source data, variable mappings and processing choices
Repeat specified meteorological data transformations and produce traceable diagnostic tables and plots
Conduct meteorological research by testing hypotheses, checking diagnostics and interpreting atmospheric processes

tasks.design: Use existing batch features in {DATA_PLATFORM} first, adding a versioned deterministic pipeline only for repeated scientist-defined transformations. Retain method selection, observation validity checks, hypothesis testing and interpretation in {DOCS} with the scientist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated data transformations and plot preparation can consume research time.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned scientific processing pipelines can rerun explicit mappings and calculations.
tasks.still_hard: Choose scientifically meaningful transformations and distinguish mechanisms from correlations.
tasks.human_edge: Design valid research and challenge apparent findings.

ambition.what: Rerun established diagnostics when a checked observation dataset is updated.

tasks.altitude: Make repeated preparation reproducible while retaining scientific reasoning.

reach.task: Validate dataset versions and processing reproducibility

evidence.claim: Copernicus openEO supports rerunnable Python or R processing over Sentinel datacubes; this demonstrates a related processing capability rather than an exact meteorological workflow.
The proposed meteorological pipeline and its time effect are unmeasured model knowledge.

assumptions: Observation providers publish source files and metadata; their existing acquisition labour remains outside this research-preparation baseline without claimed savings.

In s1 the scientist captures dataset IDs and versions, variable names, units, coordinates, time windows, missing-value rules and exact transformations; its 30 hours includes retrieval, validation and specification capture.
Two added other-role hours cover data-engineer source mapping corrections; eight added focal hours cover regression tests and method changes.
Missing metadata, changed schemas or failed validation halt the pipeline and return to manual preparation and checking in s1 and s3.
Use native batch operations before a new pipeline; no automatic hypothesis selection or scientific conclusion is generated.
This task excludes operational forecast production and already scripted preparation earns no new saving.
research_questions: Does a versioned pipeline save repeated preparation time after source validation and maintenance?

already_counted.description: Research specification and data validation capture

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=75; gross 25 minus 8 focal upkeep gives central net 17. E1 range 0-8 allows existing scripts and changing methods; research judgement remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Formulate predictions from environmental and climate evidence

steps.what: Formulate predictions by interpreting environmental, oceanic, atmospheric, paleoclimate and climate data

tasks.design: Retain environmental prediction and uncertainty assessment with the scientist using {DATA_PLATFORM} and {DOCS}. This broader task receives no duplicated saving from weather interpretation, model development or research data preparation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Environmental predictions combine heterogeneous evidence and uncertain causal relationships.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing environmental records and modelling tools support interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Assess whether evidence supports a prediction at the intended scale and horizon.
tasks.human_edge: Integrate different evidence types and make uncertainty explicit.

reach.task: Challenge cross-system assumptions and prediction limits

evidence.claim: Environmental prediction retains expert synthesis; no autonomous prediction or measured labour saving is established for this broad task.

assumptions: The baseline is synthesis rather than preparation or unattended model runtime.
Where the same weather prediction also fits the narrower weather task, its minutes are allocated once to that task during role roll-up.
No new automated service or added maintenance is introduced.
unknowns: Environmental domains and overlap with weather forecasting
research_questions: Can observation separate environmental synthesis from narrower weather prediction without double counting?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Expert prediction remains; overlapping weather minutes are allocated once.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Make repeated research preparation reproducible while retaining model and prediction judgement.
reach: Resolve observations with remote sensing scientists
Maintain data lineage with research engineers
role.ambitious_version: An atmospheric scientist who reruns checked research preparation with less repetition while retaining responsibility for model suitability and predictions.
